title: Kafka east scale-up: refuse the controller-leader
description: scale-up's cluster-safety gate on Kafka (GAP #4, batch 3 -- now fully implemented, not a stub). KafkaClusterAdapter.CanResizeVm refuses the current controller-leader (a resize would power-cycle the KRaft controller / write window) and allows followers. The meta `kafka` adapter delegates CanResizeVm to the region owning the VM. Superset demo with the actual refusal output: DEMO-161-kafka-resize-gate. Live-verified 2026-07-06 on kafka-east.

prerequisites.smokeGate: nexus-infra-kafka smoke-0.H.2 + smoke-0.H.5 ALL GREEN; role-overlay-kafka-acl-authorizer applied

observe.what: the controller-leader is identified; a scale-up of a follower is allowed, the leader refused (exit 2 with a --force-primary hint -- see DEMO-161)

whatProves: scale-up honors the controller-leader safety guard via CanResizeVm (fully implemented in batch 3; refusal output shown in DEMO-161).
